name: Mossdeep
description: An orange dwarf warming a single moss-green ocean world with one bright moon. The whole sea breathes in slow seasonal blooms visible from orbit. A sparse belt beyond holds the system's shipbreakers.

stars.name: Mossdeep Glow
stars.description: A calm orange dwarf with a steady output the biologists praise. Its light peaks exactly where the sea blooms drink deepest. Cycles here run quiet decades at a time.

planets.name: Mosssea
planets.description: A planet-wide ocean greened by continent-sized blooms of simple life. The water tastes of iron and photosynthesis. A single bright moon steadies the seasons the blooms obey.

moons.name: Bloomtide
moons.description: A pale ice moon whose tides stir the sea into blooming. Research skiffs follow its phases like a calendar. Its craters hold the cleanest ice in the system.

belts.name: Breakwater Belt
belts.description: A sparse rocky torus beyond the living world, worked by patient shipbreakers. Old hulls outnumber live rocks in the dense knots. The clans tithe a share to the sea stations.
